text: Derive the CIA triad from what an adversary can do to a channel.
choices: Confidentiality, integrity, availability are arbitrary categories
Listen, alter, prevent — defeating each gives confidentiality, integrity and availability, and the list is exhaustive because there is nothing else you can do to a channel
They come from a government standard
They correspond to the three OSI transport services
explanation: The completeness is why the triad has survived as a framework, and it is a much better reason to believe it than its appearance on a syllabus. Authentication and non-repudiation are mechanisms serving these ends, not additional ends.
